Callout.Name: Taxi Fare Dispute
Callout.Message: Passenger refusing to pay a taxi fare.
Callout.Advisory: Both on the pavement, no violence.

Script.Line: Nine dollars to here. That is not the price it should be.
I am not paying a figure that was not on the metre.
I have the money. It is the amount I am arguing about.

Lines.Approach: Nobody is hurt, nobody is armed, and they both want you to decide who is right.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
